Fourteen Minutes Past Eight

The snow has taken the road. What is left of Blackwood Manor is ten minutes.
Eight-ten to eight-twenty. Somewhere inside it the master of this house dies. You cannot stop that — it has already happened. You can only listen to it.

One wall is enough to turn speech into murmur. Your ear goes in one room at a time, so a single pass will never be enough. Rewind. Stand somewhere else. Hear the same ten minutes again.

There are five voices and you do not know a single name. Footsteps, and doors closing, are the only map you are given.

When the ten minutes end the bell rings, and Edmund Hale takes a pill from his drawer and puts it under his tongue. It is not his medicine.

In the winter of 1907, at a hospital she has not named since, Helen Moreau let a patient die and altered one line of the record. Edmund Hale found that line, and used it to ask her for a signature.
At fourteen minutes past eight by the wall clock, Helen opened the right-hand drawer of the study desk. She carried out the brown bottle with its twenty-four nitroglycerin tablets and left twelve sugar pills of the same colour and size in its place. Nobody tastes what they put under their tongue.
The real bottle was in the cellar, wedged under the coal bin beneath a handful of ash. The ash did not burn the label — St Allen Sanatorium.

Case closed.

Your reasoning did not reach the truth.
At half past eight the bell rang. The study door stood open, and twelve pills that do nothing at all were still lying in the right-hand drawer.

Voice v1 is Clara Boss, the private secretary of the house
Voice v2 is Marco Bellini, the cook
Voice v3 is Julian Hale, the victim's nephew
Voice v4 is Helen Moreau, the attending physician
Voice v5 is Edmund Hale, the master of the house
Without the nitroglycerin tablets in the brown bottle in his study drawer, Edmund cannot survive an attack
Edmund had found Helen's falsified 1907 record and was holding it over her
Helen let a patient die at a former hospital and altered the record
This point in the run is fourteen minutes past eight by the wall clock
At that moment the brown bottle in the study's right-hand drawer was being swapped
The substituted pills are sugar and do nothing for the heart
The swap happened in the right-hand drawer of the study desk
A brown bottle labelled St Allen Sanatorium is hidden in the cellar coal bin
Someone saw Helen coming out of the cellar
The five voices: v1 Clara Boss, v2 Marco Bellini, v3 Julian Hale, v4 Helen Moreau, v5 Edmund Hale
The killer is voice v4 — Helen Moreau, the attending physician
The motive was blackmail — Edmund held her altered record and demanded a signature
The time of the act was fourteen minutes past eight by the wall clock
The place was the study — the right-hand drawer of the desk
The method was substitution — sugar pills in place of nitroglycerin, so the attack could not be stopped
The decisive evidence is the brown bottle labelled St Allen Sanatorium, hidden in the cellar coal bin
